root_cause: The GitHub Actions runner could not reach the Ubuntu Azure mirror (azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80) during apt-get install in the Debian Packages job. This is a transient network connectivity issue on the CI runner infrastructure, unrelated to any code changes in the PR. The PR only adds an ONNX Swish-24 operation translator and documentation updates.
reproduction_steps: N/A - infrastructure network issue not reproducible locally
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed Debian Packages job or re-add the PR to the merge queue
If the issue persists, investigate Azure runner network connectivity to ubuntu mirrors
prevention_strategies: Consider retry logic in debian package installation scripts or use alternative Ubuntu mirrors as fallback.
historical_context: Network connectivity failures to azure.archive.ubuntu.com are a known transient issue on GitHub-hosted runners.
